source.sectionTitle: Pediatric Bradycardia With a Pulse Algorithm

record.item: Pediatric Bradycardia With a Pulse Algorithm (RMMCH)

symptoms: Patient with bradycardia and Cardiopulmonary compromise: Acutely altered mental status, Signs of shock, Hypotension.

management_steps.details: Maintain patent airway, assist breathing with PPV and oxygen. Cardiac monitor, pulse, BP, oximetry. Start CPR if HR < 60/min despite oxygenation and ventilation.

Continue CPR if HR < 60/min. IV/IO access. Epinephrine IV/IO dose: 0.01 mg/kg (0.1 mL/kg of the 0.1 mg/mL concentration) repeat every 3-5 minutes (if ET tube in place: ET dose 0.1 mg/kg [0.1 mL/kg of 1 mg/mL concentration]). Atropine IV/IO dose: 0.02 mg/kg for increased vagal tone or primary AV block (may repeat once; min dose 0.1 mg, max single dose 0.5 mg). Consider transthoracic/transvenous pacing.

warnings: Check pulse every 2 minutes; if pulse absent, go to Pediatric Cardiac Arrest Algorithm.
